name: Creamy Tuna Pasta Salad with Peas, Carrots, Celery, Tomato & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp dill, dried

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
6 sticks celery
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Rinse peas under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
Drain tuna, add to the bowl, and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Add cooled pasta to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the pasta salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
